summary: Pend Oreille County 30-ft L-4 pole lookout, built 1936, staffed through at least 1946; removed or destroyed in the 1960s; footings reported.

facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed in the 1960s; sources disagree on which; a WillhiteWeb photo caption reports footings on site

access.note: WillhiteWeb, as of 2023, lists access as any vehicle but notes a year-long wildlife closure on the road and shows a gate; whether foot travel is allowed is not stated

visit.trail_note: Hiking distance 2.6 miles one way per WillhiteWeb; no tower to climb; only the last quarter mile of road was starting to grow over (as of 2023)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says removed in the 1960s; Firelookout.com says destroyed in the 1960s; WillhiteWeb says removed or destroyed in the 1960s; Forest Lookouts says removed, with no date. Three of four sources date it to the 1960s, and the manner is disputed. Not resolved; all are reported.
Register and Firelookout.com give 1936 for the tower; WillhiteWeb says the Forest Service began on the station in 1935 and the tower was finished in 1936. Both are consistent.

notes_for_editor: Removal verb disputed (removed vs destroyed), decade given by three sources (Forest Lookouts gives none). Staffing names come from 1940 and 1946 newspaper reports quoted by Forest Lookouts and WillhiteWeb; those reports are the only staffing evidence. Footings and display captions are undated. Access notes are from WillhiteWeb as of 2023; closure status should be checked with the Colville National Forest.
